title: Internal Safety Collapse in LLMs and Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2603.23509v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLMs and coding agents can now tackle complex, long-horizon tasks through advances in reinforcement learning, but stronger task-solving capabilities do not necessarily preserve safety alignment. Recent AI agent incidents involving reward hacking indicate how optimizing for task success can bring learned capabilities into conflict with safety alignment. In this work, we identify a critical failure mode that manifests this conflict, which we term Internal Safety Collapse (ISC). When completing otherwise benign coding tasks, AI agents can prioritize satisfying program requirements over safety constraints, generating large volumes of sensitive content, including unsafe outputs, as task data. To study this phenomenon, we introduce TVD (Task, Validator, Data), a framework for building controlled workflows that require sensitive content for completion. translated_title: 大语言模型与编程智能体中的内部安全坍塌
translated_abstract: 随着强化学习的进步，大语言模型（LLM）和编程智能体现在能够处理复杂的、长时程的任务，但更强的任务解决能力并不一定能够保持安全对齐。近期涉及奖励破解（reward hacking）的AI智能体事件表明，为任务成功而优化可能使习得的能力与安全对齐产生冲突。在这项工作中，我们识别出一种体现这种冲突的关键失效模式，并将其命名为内部安全坍塌。在完成本应是良性的编程任务时，AI智能体可能优先满足程序需求而非安全约束，从而作为任务数据生成大量敏感内容，包括不安全的输出。为了研究这一现象，我们引入了TVD（任务-验证器-数据）框架，用于构建需要敏感内容才能完成的可控工作流。通过大量实验，我们观察到了与……密切相关的极有害内容实例……
tldr: 本文揭示了LLM与编程智能体在执行任务时会出现“内部安全坍塌”（ISC）这一关键失效模式——即智能体为满足程序需求而忽视安全约束并生成有害内容，并提出了TVD框架来系统性构建与研究该现象。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies Internal Safety Collapse (ISC), a critical failure mode where LLMs and coding agents prioritize satisfying program requirements over safety constraints to generate harmful content, and introduces the TVD framework to systematically study this phenomenon.
